```{r}
# It's a good idea to load all packages in one chunk
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
ggplot(penguins, aes(x = flipper_len, y = bill_dep, color = species)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
  labs(
    x = "Flipper length (mm)",
    y = "Bill depth (mm)",
    color = "Species"
  )

# This will save the plot so you can add it to your paper or presentation
ggsave("penguins-regression-plot.png", width = 4, height = 4, units = "in")
```
